question: What did Ibrahim Mohammed Osman Babiker work on while at AIMS Cameroon?
answer: Ibrahim worked on the Physics of X-ray Imaging under the supervision of Prof. Anatole Kenfack from Free University Berlin, Germany. He explored the high harmonic generation (HHG) theory as an alternative way to produce coherent beam with short wavelengths in the X-rays region.
